candidates.summary: relaxing Tx.ValidateBasic to accept an empty fee makes `gnogenesis verify` pass a zero-fee genesis tx that a node on the default closed credit window rejects at InitChain
candidates.failure_scenario: The tm2 ADR says the ante rejects a 0-fee tx right after ValidateBasic unless the window is open; that holds for the ante only. contribs/gnogenesis/internal/verify/verify.go:94 relied on tx.Tx.ValidateBasic() to refuse a zero fee. A genesis.json carrying a tx with an empty fee now passes `gnogenesis verify` (master refused it), then `gnoland start` with the default MaxGasCreditPerTx 0 delivers it through the ante, which returns InsufficientFee 'zero-fee transactions require a non-zero Block.MaxGasCreditPerTx', and NewApp's default PanicOnFailingTxResultHandler (gno.land/pkg/gnoland/app.go:391) panics InitChain; with SkipFailingTxs the tx is dropped silently. The verifier reports success on a genesis the chain cannot boot from.
candidates.verify_by: cp tests/b1-claims-zero-fee-genesis-verify_test.go contribs/gnogenesis/internal/verify/ && (cd contribs/gnogenesis && go test -count=1 -run TestB1ClaimsVerifyAcceptsZeroFeeGenesisTx ./internal/verify/): PASS at head, FAIL at 3cc494ec4; then go test -count=1 -run TestAnteHandlerRejectsZeroFeeWhenCreditWindowDisabled ./tm2/pkg/sdk/auth/ for the node-side rejection in DeliverTx
candidates.evidence: head 1f043ddb1: 'tx.ValidateBasic() = <nil>', 'gnogenesis verify error = <nil>', '--- PASS: TestB1ClaimsVerifyAcceptsZeroFeeGenesisTx'; '--- PASS: TestAnteHandlerRejectsZeroFeeWhenCreditWindowDisabled' (DeliverTx and CheckTx both InsufficientFeeError with the window closed); app.go:391 'GenesisTxResultHandler: PanicOnFailingTxResultHandler'. Base tx.go: 'if !tx.Fee.GasFee.IsValid()' rejects Coin{} (empty denom fails validate).

candidates.summary: every txtar runs with the credit window open and the validator opted in, so the shipped configuration (window closed) has no end-to-end test
candidates.failure_scenario: SetupGnolandTestscript sets MaxGasCreditPerTx = 10_000_000 for every txtar (the comment says for the paygas_*/paystorage_* ones) and TestingNodeConfig sets AllowZeroFeeTxs true (node_testing.go:103); -max-gas only caps the window, never closes it. The body and both ADRs claim that with the window closed a 0-fee tx is rejected in every mode with master's error and fee-paying txs are unchanged; that rests on ante unit tests alone, and no txtar sends a 0-fee gnokey tx to a closed-window node through CheckTx and DeliverTx. A regression in the closed-window path (the one every chain runs today) passes the whole integration suite.
candidates.verify_by: grep the integration runner for any way to leave MaxGasCreditPerTx at 0 and grep testdata for a 0-fee tx expected to fail with 'insufficient fee' on a closed window: none; add a runner switch and a txtar sending -gas-fee 0ugnot with the window closed, expecting InsufficientFee at CheckTx
candidates.evidence: testscript_gnoland.go:293 'bp.MaxGasCreditPerTx = 10_000_000' unconditional; node_testing.go:103 'AllowZeroFeeTxs: true'; grep -rln MaxGasCreditPerTx testdata/ returns only paygas_credit_exhausted.txtar
